decisions.reason: Product A is a formwork profile system closely related to existing formwork and machinery knowledge, and the firm's in-house R&D helps assimilate early results, so keep.
Product B builds on the firm's established automation and control competence, and its own R&D provides absorptive capacity to improve it, so keep.
Product C is a shuttering magnet block close to existing formwork products, and the firm's related knowledge and R&D enable learning, so keep.
Product D is magnetic formwork strips close to established formwork offerings, and the firm's R&D base supports interpreting market feedback, so keep.
Product E is a magnetic formwork component close to the firm's established range, and in-house R&D helps it learn and improve, so keep.
Product F is a magnetic formwork component close to existing products, and the firm's absorptive capacity from R&D supports keeping it.
